product.name: Consumer Credit Loans
product.description: Online loans ranging from €1,000 to €50,000 for various personal and business purposes, available to individuals including private persons, students, and self-employed.

product.name: Sorglos-Paket (Credit Protection Package)
product.description: An optional insurance product that covers loan repayments in cases of disability, serious illness, unemployment, cessation of self-employment, or death during the loan term.

product.name: auxmoney Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application that allows borrowers to monitor their loan status and manage personal data anytime and anywhere.
